name: Enterprise Autonomous Customer Service & AI Supervisor Pipeline

parameters.content:
### 01 | INGESTION & HEURISTIC TRIAGE
Captures omnichannel payload and performs sub-millisecond fast-path evaluation for explicit human agent requests.

### 02 | AI SUPERVISOR & RISK CLASSIFICATION
Deep LLM classification assessing customer sentiment, churn probability, purchase intent, and automated escalation criteria.

### 03 | SYNTHESIS & ENTERPRISE GUARDRAILS (P0)
Generates context-grounded resolution via knowledge base and enforces strict runtime isolation to prevent internal note leakage.

### 04 | DISPATCH & INCIDENT ALERTING
Asynchronously delivers safe client response while routing critical escalations and high-intent leads to human personnel.
